metadataDraft.subtitle: 标牌检查与现场记录
metadataDraft.promotionalText: 记录标牌观察、照片和已执行工作。保留本地历史记录，准备可共享的 PDF 报告。
metadataDraft.description:
AssetRounds 帮助记录标牌检查。保存可见状况的观察、备注、照片和工作记录。查看历史、进行复查，并准备 PDF 报告。

记录保留在此设备上。共享报告会打开系统选项，不代表已经交付。观察记录不构成认证、诊断或合规判定。

此内容为待审核草稿。发布前须根据最终版本确认可用功能和语言。
metadataDraft.keywords: 标牌,检查,照片,证据,报告,巡检,工作

reviewRequirements: Professional translator and independent Simplified Chinese native review
Bilingual U.S. sign-workflow terminology review; no cross-script conversion acceptance
CJK keyboard marked-text composition, no forced spaces, compact labels and largest Dynamic Type
VoiceOver pronunciation, focus order, permission/error/recovery/destructive states
Font license/coverage, line breaking, Letter/A4 PDF extraction, semantic order and printing
Reconcile after S and integrate only through P04-C07
